verdict.rationale: Synctera has a first-party ACH guide and mentions issuing ACH debits against verified external accounts. It also documents a Webhook API for subscribing to platform events, so ACH origination through the API is plausibly supported. Nothing in the pack shows credits, same-day windows, or returns, NOCs and reversals as first-class objects. Missing for 10: explicit ACH credit and debit origination endpoints, same-day ACH windows, returns/NOCs/reversals modeled as objects, ACH-specific webhook events, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can originate ACH through the API — credits and debits, same-day windows, and the unhappy paths (returns, NOCs, reversals) modeled as first-class objects with webhooks

citations.quote: ACH is a one-stop shop for a variety of payment use cases.
Verifying an external account unlocks capabilities such as balance checks before issuing ACH debits
The Webhook API enables integrators to subscribe to specific events on the Synctera platform.
